RPGTable.title: RPG Custom Tab Table
RPGTable.description: Custom tables for RPG stats and items including Compendium, Weapons, Inventory, Magic, and Journal.

userId.description: The firebase auth user ID of the owner of this table.

tabName.description: Name of the RPG tab (e.g., Compendium, Weapons, Inventory, Magic, Journal)

columns.description: List of columns in this table with header names or ids.

rows.description: The rows of the table where keys map to the column definitions.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this table was last saved.

RPGSettings.title: RPG User Settings and State
RPGSettings.description: General settings, character details, tabletop positions, or custom spells for the authenticated user.

userId.description: The firebase auth user ID of the owner of this configuration document.

type.description: The setting category types (e.g., character, preferences, tabletop).

payload.description: The serialized key-value structure of the settings, stats, or logs.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this configuration document was last saved.

RPGItem.title: RPG Item Definition
RPGItem.description: Custom or standard VTT items stored securely with exact stats and effects under the user's document.

itemId.description: Unique identifier for this item instance.

quantity.description: Amount of the item currently owned.

category.description: Category of the item (e.g., weapons, utility, gear).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this item was last modified.

/users/{userId}.description: User root document containing user profile and ownership anchor.

/users/{userId}/tables/{tableId}.description: A customized RPG grid table for the authenticated user, saved under their distinct userId.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: User-scoped configurations containing character sheet details, app preferences, and tabletop states.

/users/{userId}/items/{itemId}.description: Dedicated items database storing custom and pre-seeded weapon, slot, and inventory items for each user.
